name: Buried Sand-Shrike

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sand-shrike makes two Raptorial Limb attacks.

Actions.name: Raptorial Limb
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Erupting Ambush (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: If the sand-shrike is burrowing, it erupts from the ground at a point within 5 feet of one creature. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 15, that creature. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. The sand-shrike then makes one Raptorial Limb attack against the target. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Prone condition

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the sand-shrike takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Coiled Patience
Traits.text: If the sand-shrike has not moved since the end of its last turn, its next Raptorial Limb attack that hits deals an additional 11 (2d10) Slashing damage.
Traits.clause: If the sand-shrike has not moved since the end of its last turn, its next Raptorial Limb attack that hits deals an addit
Traits.expressedQuote: If the sand-shrike has not moved since the end of its last turn

lore: Sand-shrikes are desert brood-hunters that lay egg clusters in buried caravans and wait, motionless as stone, for the tremor of footsteps they can feel through their plating.

generation.userConcept: a sand-shrike that is only dangerous on the turn after it goes still
